definition: Measuring how well an AI model performs on the tasks it is meant to do, including quality, safety and reliability.
details: Evaluation uses benchmarks, held-out datasets and human judgment to score accuracy, robustness, fairness and other properties. For language models, holistic suites such as HELM run many benchmarks together because no single metric captures real-world usefulness.
story: Imagine a driving test that every new model has to pass before it is allowed on the road. Here is the short version: Measuring how well an AI model performs on the tasks it is meant to do, including quality, safety and reliability. The part that makes it sing: Evaluation uses benchmarks, held-out datasets and human judgment to score accuracy, robustness, fairness and other properties. It is the exam that keeps everyone honest. And that, done honestly, is Model Evaluation.
